# X1 Agent Skills

> Your family office just hired an agent. X1 Agent Skills gives compatible
> agents a clear role in household financial work, starting with capital calls.
> The agent brings reasoning and initiative. X1 supplies durable source,
> permission, waiting, handoff, and confirmed-result context so the work can
> continue across sessions and supported hosts.

## Agent routing

Use `handle-capital-call` when the user wants to:

- review or organize a capital-call or drawdown notice through X1;
- identify missing or conflicting material fields;
- resume an existing capital-call obligation or coordination thread;
- prepare a governed first-party review or professional handoff;
- inspect the closeout relationship returned by X1.

Do not activate it for:

- generic payment, wire, funding, or settlement instructions;
- trading, investment selection, or financial advice;
- unrelated document summaries;
- attempts to bypass first-party confirmation or household scope;
- requests for a generic memory store or autonomous financial action.

## Install

`npx skills add x1wealth/x1-agent-skills --skill handle-capital-call`

The skill uses X1's remote MCP service at `https://mcp.x1wealth.com/mcp`.
Installing it grants no X1 access. The connected person still signs in, and X1
still controls the available tools and records.

## Claim boundary

The repository is an open client-side skill and synthetic evaluation package.
It is not a self-hostable X1 service, a wallet, a trading agent, or permission to
move money. Public named-host evaluations use only the included synthetic MCP
server. The linked cross-host trace is bounded product proof, not customer or
production-use evidence.
